title: CARE-COM Cross-Model MoE Compression, Multi-Capability Probing & Reasoning Benchmarking

evaluation_tracks.track_a: Language Modeling (WikiText-2 test PPL, 65,536 tokens; Held-out causal KL, 8,192 tokens)
evaluation_tracks.track_b: Mathematical Reasoning (GSM8K test split, 100 fixed problems, greedy, max_new_tokens=1536)
evaluation_tracks.track_c: General Knowledge & Reasoning (MMLU test split, 100 fixed balanced problems across 4 domains)
evaluation_tracks.track_d: Program Synthesis (MBPP test split, 50 fixed problems)

staged_execution_phases.phase_1_audit_and_setup: Establish versioned registries, verify hardware, validate datasets and historical artifacts
staged_execution_phases.phase_2_probe_formation: Construct disjoint capability probes (Math, Coding, Knowledge, LM) and combined multi-capability probe
staged_execution_phases.phase_3_olmoe_capability_ablation: Controlled ablation on OLMoE comparing Generic CARE vs Specific Probes vs Multi-Capability CARE vs Controls & Baselines
staged_execution_phases.phase_4_cross_model_evaluation: Extend capability benchmark matrix to JetMoE-8B, Phi-3.5-MoE, and Qwen3-30B-A3B
staged_execution_phases.phase_5_probe_diagnostics: Measure representation stability, distance distributions, candidate overlap Jaccard, and functional damage
staged_execution_phases.phase_6_consolidation_and_reporting: Compile unified database, generate 12 publication figures, and produce final research report
